verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence says Vanta hosts a separate MCP server in each region and tells users to find the region of their Vanta instance. That implies tenants are hosted in distinct regions, but nothing documents letting a customer choose that region or make residency commitments. missing for 10: explicit documentation that customers can select their data region at signup or migration, a list of available regions and residency guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
